mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in housing starts relative to the previous quarter signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past two months indicates robust supply chain activity and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and slowdown in GDP growth (GDPC1) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS decline and GDPC1 slowdown fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), a rising federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.
